name: The 11th Angkor Empire Marathon 2026
short_description: A 42.195 km full marathon held in front of Angkor Wat Temple, Siem Reap, Cambodia, on August 2, 2026.
ai_summary: The 11th Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 is a full marathon covering 42.195 km, scheduled for August 2, 2026, in front of Angkor Wat Temple in Siem Reap, Cambodia. This edition marks the eleventh running of the event at this historic location.

core_facts.venue: In front of Angkor Wat Temple, Siem Reap

pros: Full marathon through the Angkor park, passing Ta Prohm, Pre Rup and the Bayon
Flat single loop with water every 2 km and electrolyte drinks at about half the stations
Medical tents, first-aid tuk-tuks and an ambulance following the race
Small, slow marathon field: in 2025 a 3:36 marathon placed tenth
cons: Saturated air: 25°C, dew point 25°C and 100% humidity at the 4.30am start in 2026
Marathon limit cut to 6 hours 30 in 2026, from 7 hours
Runners reported 10 km runners blocking faster runners around the Bayon
Full 2026 results had not been published by late September
research_highlights: Course is flat and mostly paved, running through Angkor Archaeological Park past nearly 40 ancient temples including Bayon and the South Gate of Angkor Thom
Race starts at 4:30 AM in front of Angkor Wat, so the first stretch of the course is run in darkness
August timing means heat and especially humidity are a major factor; the 2025 edition drew over 4,000 runners from 51 countries and 2026 organisers expect around 4,500
Four distance options (3km, 10km, half marathon, marathon), with the full and half marathon AIMS-recognised/certified courses
Local children along the route are reported as an enthusiastic, memorable part of the atmosphere even where formal spectator crowds are thin
research_watchouts: Humidity is repeatedly flagged by runners as the toughest element of the race, even though the course itself is flat and easy
Very early 4:30 AM start means a pre-3 AM wake-up and a dark first few kilometres with limited visibility
Outside the main Angkor Wat start/finish area, spectator support along the course is reportedly sparse
Runners caution against booking temple tours or heavy sightseeing for the afternoon immediately after the race due to fatigue

faqs.question: What distance is the Angkor Empire Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 is a full marathon with a primary distance of 42.195 km, the standard internationally recognized marathon length. This is the only distance option confirmed for this edition of the race, held in Siem Reap, Cambodia, in front of the historic Angkor Wat Temple.

faqs.question: Can I register for the 2026 Angkor Empire Marathon now?
faqs.answer: According to the available information. This means specific sign-up dates, entry fees, and application procedures are not currently available. Interested runners should watch for future announcements regarding when and how registration will open.

faqs.question: Where exactly does the marathon start or take place?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in front of Angkor Wat Temple, located in Siem Reap, Cambodia. This iconic venue serves as the setting for the event, giving participants the experience of running near one of Cambodia's most recognizable historic landmarks during the marathon.

faqs.question: When is the 11th Angkor Empire Marathon scheduled to happen?
faqs.answer: The 11th Angkor Empire Marathon is scheduled for August 2, 2026. It will be held in Siem Reap, Cambodia, with the course centered in front of the Angkor Wat Temple, marking the eleventh edition of this full-marathon event at this location.
